svg.title: Verdance cup — Great Digital Debate supporting line in PP NeueBit
svg.desc: Official Verdance wordmark preserved from its original SVG with unchanged placement. Refined pixel Capitol with an evenly aligned first-floor colonnade and no brown doorway block. Draft lower-cup placement, not a measured cup template.

svg.title: Verdance Capitol — taller upper columns without triangular pediment
svg.desc: Every stepped contour, square foliage accent, tree trunk, column, opening and sun block is aligned to one shared unit grid. The baseline is a deliberately smooth thin line. Transparent background. No brown doorway.
